items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Because the first time I played with him, boy, every horn player in America showed up.

ctx.x: Yeah. See, because I always did play kind of weird. I think that’s what he was talking about. He was the type of man that, I tried to get that. I got that from him. He gave everybody their due, let everybody play. Because the first time I played with him, boy, every horn player in America showed up. Now I’m on the gig. I standing back, saying, play Mr. Parker, play. These cats are trying to get on the bandstand and say they played with Bird.
